title: spaex Molecule Manifest v4 - install_hook fragment (spec 016)
description: Schema fragment that MUST be merged into src/spaex/schema/data/molecule-manifest.v4.schema.json to add the optional install_hook field. This fragment shows the addition only; the surrounding v4 manifest schema is unchanged. The `$defs.repoRelativePath` reference is the same one already defined in molecule-manifest.v4.schema.json.

interpreter.description: Program name looked up on PATH (python3, bash, node, ...). spaex verifies existence via shutil.which() before invocation; a missing interpreter is a hook failure subject to on_failure policy.

script.description: Molecule-directory-relative path to the hook script. spaex resolves it against the pinned molecule cache directory; the canonical target must remain inside the cache even through symlinks (path-containment check enforced at execution time).

args.description: Additional positional arguments passed after the script. Optional; absent parses to an empty list.

on_failure.description: Failure policy. 'abort' triggers Spec-008 install-transaction rollback on any hook failure (non-zero exit, OSError on launch, missing interpreter, path-containment failure). 'warn' records hook_status:failed in install.lock and continues, exit 0. Default is 'abort'; the parser MUST set the value explicitly rather than relying on this default metadata.

install_hook.description: Optional side-effect script that spaex install invokes after atoms materialization, per molecule in effective-priority order. Runs with cwd = consumer repo root, inherits stdio AND the invoking spaex process's complete environment. Side effects are not reversible by spaex remove; spaex remove emits a WARN when removing a molecule that declared install_hook.
